title: Peruvian Ceviche
description: A refreshing Peruvian-style ceviche made with fresh fish, lime juice, and spices. Perfect for a light and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: Peruvian Ceviche Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Latin American markets

instructions: Cut the fish into small, uniform pieces and place in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, combine lime juice, onion, pepper, and spice mix.
Pour the lime juice mixture over the fish and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Just before serving, stir in chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
